reportedIssues: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which would imply the food is completely free. This looks like a data/styling error and is confusing to users.

The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge with its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...'). This may be intentional horizontal scroll, but the truncation is abrupt.
The notification badge dot on the bell icon has low contrast against the red dot and may be hard to perceive for color-blind users.
Illustrative food images vary in style (photo-like plate vs. flat illustration), creating slight visual inconsistency across cards.

expected.reasoning: Reported 0 describes the same -100% discount badge on the pizza card.
